eps.t: Berlint Panic | The Informant and Nightfall
eps.ov: The Forgers enjoy a day off while Nightfall hires Franky to help her on a mission.

eps.t: Avoid Getting Tonitrus Bolts | ■■■■'s Memories I
eps.ov: Anya's class must avoid getting Tonitrus Bolts and we get a glimpse into someone's past.
Loid recalls what happened in the past that led him to where he is today.

eps.t: Behind the Scandal | The Path to an Imperial Scholar
eps.ov: WISE agents protect an opera singer and Henderson gives Anya tips on becoming an Imperial Scholar.
Yor goes out shopping and happens to save someone quite unexpected.

eps.t: White Jealousy | The Eden College Busjacking Incident
eps.ov: A doctor's jealousy gets Loid into some trouble at the hospital and Anya's class goes on a field trip.
A bus carrying Anya's class is busjacked by some terrorists.
Henderson gets on the bus to give the children food and water. Billy remembers his purpose in life.
Anya, Becky, Damian, and Bill are given Stella Stars for their quick thinking during the busjacking.

eps.t: Austin's Troubles | A Normal Mixer | Moon Landing
eps.ov: Mr. Austin is having nightmares after the busjacking incident and Yor goes out with her coworkers.
Twilight and Yuri get an emergency summons from their respective agencies.

eps.t: Battle to the Death in the Sewers
eps.ov: The WISE agents and the State Security Service agents clash in the sewers.

eps.t: A World Where We Cannot Survive
eps.ov: The battle in the sewers reaches its conclusion and Loid tries to remedy his relationship with Yor.
